The Merciless Wastes is a large area in K'aresh that encompasses Castigaar, The Lunnall River, Sufaad, and The Tempest Fields. It is also where The Oasis and the ruins of Eco-Dome: Rhovan are located. According to legend, all of K'aresh used to be The Merciless Wastes until the worldsoul K'aresh created the Wilds. Contrary to that Locus-Walker once remarked that "the oracles turned the Merciless Wastes into a garden" with the use of the Reshii Ribbons. The subzone itself is broken up between the various zones the region itself occupies.

The Midnight Gameplay Reveal is the showcase trailer for World of Warcraft: Midnight, published on 19 August 2025. It shows off various features of Midnight, including a an updated Quel'Thalas zone, the Harandar, The Voidstorm, and Zul'Aman as new zones, Prey and Housing systems, the Haranir as an allied race, and a new demon hunter spec.

Midnight Herald's Shroud is the cloak appearance belonging to the Midnight Herald's Pledge appearance set. It can only be obtained as an equippable item by converting a Season 3 cloak at the Catalyst in Dornogal, though the appearance can be purchased via Ensemble: Midnight Herald's Shrouds.

Midnight Herald's Clasp can be obtained by converting another The War Within Season 3 belt using the Catalyst. It is part of the Midnight Herald's Pledge set but is not required to benefit from the tier bonus.

Midnight Herald's Wristguards can be obtained by converting another pair of The War Within Season 3 bracers using the Catalyst. They are part of the Midnight Herald's Pledge set but are not required to benefit from the tier bonus.

Midnight Herald's Jackboots can be obtained by converting another pair of The War Within Season 3 boots using the Catalyst. They is part of the Midnight Herald's Pledge set but are not required to benefit from the tier bonus.

Midnight proficiency is a profession proficiency learned at the appropriate profession trainer when a character has reached at least level 80. Midnight animated shorts is a series of animated shorts released as a prelude to World of Warcraft: Midnight. The first episode, Supremacy, released on 9 February 2026. Mimir's Anvils are a pair of anvils located in Mimir's Workshop in the Storm Peaks. Three inactive Mechagnome Attendants can be found lying on one of them.
Mindpiercer's Sigil drops from Charonus in the Voidscar Arena.
Mind-Seeker Apprentices are located at the Seat of Knowledge during the Mind-Seeker secret.

The Mindless Abomination is an abomination summoned by using Abomination Assembly Kit at Halgrind in the Howling Fjord during Warning: Some Assembly Required. The Mindless Abomination is then controlled by the player.
Mine-Bot 5000X are siege engines located at the factions' landing site on the Isle of Dorn. They are being worked on by Gnome Engineers.
Mind Worms are larvae that spawn from Void Tears in Uldum and the Vale of Eternal Blossoms during Black Empire assaults.
Miniature Soulmasses are oozes found in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Miniature Charging Station is housing decor that can be purchased for 20 Community Coupons from Pascal-K1N6, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Moderate Mechanization endeavor. The neighborhood must reach the fourth milestone of the endeavor before it becomes available to purchase.
Militia Commander Balor is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Mining-on-Demand is a profession achievement earned by completing 4 weekly quests for Midnight Mining.
Minding Our Duty is a weekly quest for Saltheril's Soiree that becomes available after choosing the in Favor of the Court or by giving Saltheril's Favor to Magistrix Bloodflame.
Miniature Hand-Crafted Mask is looted from the Crumbling Urn in the Ring of Glory on the Coiled Isle.

Mining nodes are protrusions of minerals found throughout World of Warcraft, acting as the resource node for the Mining profession. Miners can gather crafting reagents such as ore, gems, and stone from them.
Mischievous Podlings are podling located in the Barrows of Reverie in the Emerald Dream. They appear just before Fruitface spawns.
Mining Carts would have unlocked new functions for Lunarfall Excavation or Frostwall Mine.
Minion of Deathwingurlugull is a murloc located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Misshapen Drakonid Goblet drops from Doomshadow in the Azure Span.
Minions of Ghur'sha are merciless ones located in the Throne of the Tides.
Mischievous Ducks are ducks located in Durotar and Elwynn Forest. They wander back and forth between both Goldshire and Razor Hill and the relaxation spot of the ducks, as seen in Just a Waddle Away.
Minor Bronze Cache is awarded from various sources in the WoW Remix events.
Mislaid Tools are located in Shadowvein Point in the Ringing Deeps.

Minor Spool of Eternal Thread is a once-daily reward from each random dungeon heroic dungeon, scenario, heroic scenario, LFR wing and world boss during Pandaria Remix for level 30–49 characters. It contains 20 threads (or 40 stamina) for the Cloak of Infinite Potential, increased to 60 (or 120 stamina) with Timerunner's Mastery.
Mischa is a house cat located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.
Mislaid Curiosity are found throughout delves. They come in various models, including bags, mushrooms, vases, or ethereal containers.
Mining Tools are looted from Abandoned Tools in the Rumbling Wastes in the Ringing Deeps.

Missed 'Em by That Much is awarded to players who defeat Queen Ansurek after all players use Abyssal Conduits to travel underneath her during Frothing Gluttony in Nerub-ar Palace on Normal or higher difficulties. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Nerub-ar Raider. In the third phase, two players will get targeted with Abyssal Conduit, which can be placed on the ground to avoid the Frothing Gluttony as it collapses toward the center. Normally, the two conduits will be in the same part of the arena, but for the achievement, the "inner" conduit should be on one side of the boss, and the "outer" conduit should be on the other. Mirror of the Sky is an area located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Miral Murder-Mittens is an imperial lynx located in Hillhelm Stead in Hallowfall. Miral tried to alert Aliya Hillhelm of her brother's absence, so Aliya sent an adventurer to follow Miral. Miral let them outside beyond Torchlight Mine, finding Tomothy's items. She led them to Isaec's Folly where the adventurer found and saved Tomothy.
Mire Fertilizers are fungrets located in Maldraxxus. Summoned by Fungret Shroomtenders, they pass out or die soon after appearing. They are also found inside Plaguefall

The Mirehat fungarians are a colony of fungarians, led by Darkcap Tain, that can be found in the Stagnant Mire in Hallowfall. They have infested the area, threatening the nearby Arathi with parasitic parasitic fungal attacks. Their fungalmancers use Cultivated Mireshrooms as pets and they seem to peacefully share the swamp with the Sludgeborn Shamblers that can also be found there. Great Kyron tasked adventurers with slaying Darkcap Tain and collecting the spores to prevent a new fungal army and give the Arathi a respite from their ongoing threat. Maera Ashyld meanwhile had adventurers collect various mementos that ended up in the hands of the Mirehat fungarians.
Mirehat Sporedancers are fungarians located in the Stagnant Mire in Hallowfall.
Mirehat Fungalmancers are fungarians located in the Stagnant Mire in Hallowfall.
Minnow's Favorite Blade can be found stuck in a ceiling beam inside the Salt and Shanty on the Siren Isle.

Mint-Scented Candle Hat can be found in treasure room chests of kobold delves. This item can also be purchased for 2,600 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson. From The War Within Season 1 to Season 3, this item can be purchased for 2,500 Undercoin from Sir Finley Mrrgglton.
Miscellaneous Mechanica drop from all rares across Undermine. Use them to purchase companion pets from Ditty Fuzeboy and mounts from Skedgit Cinderbangs.

Mint Condition Gallagio Anniversary Coin drops from the Gallagio Garbage at S.C.R.A.P. job sites in Undermine. The money golem has a chance of spawning when the S.C.R.A.P. bar fills up.

Minor Water Spirits are water elementals located in the Crystal Hall in the Exodar. Most are located in the Light Blessed Waters, while another appears during Chakaa's guided tour. The spirits are only visible while under the effects of the Elemental Sapta provided by Seer Skaltesh.
Mirage, Rod of Illusion drops from the Reborn Council in the Scarlet Enclave.
Mirror Powder is a finishing crafting reagent made with Khaz Algar Enchanting. It can be learned from Nagad in Dornogal for when the Enchanter has reached skill level 10 in Khaz Algar Enchanting.
Mirestained Scout's Mantle can be purchased from Churbro in Boralus and Zuldazar for .

Misplaced Shipments are looted from Wastelander ethereals in North Sufaad on K'aresh while on Smuggler's Mark (quest). They can also be looted from Vesto's Stolen Goods. They contribute 8-10% of the "Fill Vesto's pack with items" bar.
Mining at Midnight is a profession achievement earned by obtaining 100 skill points in Midnight Mining. It rewards the Midnight Miner's Shop Sign decor.
Minute Horrors are observers located at the Tempest Fields on K'aresh.
Mirrorvise was a crystal scorpid located in Verrall River in the Twilight Highlands.
